assumptions: As-published network: the load susceptance is taken out of B_lap, because the source states that its loads play no role in the small-signal admittance model (printed p. 4); the line charging and the declared bus shunt capacitance are kept, an assumption of this implementation: the pages of the source read (printed pp. 4-8) do not settle how it treats line charging and other shunts.
Loads-absorbed network: B_lap as the reduced chain builds it (loads as susceptance at the power-flow voltages), the network of lambda_min(A).
The monitor's score in the paired tests is the five-seed score-averaged ensemble of the stored deployed predictions, the paired-test convention of e8_paired_test.py and r21_design_baseline.py.

As published without shunts: the load susceptance, the line charging and the declared bus shunt capacitance are taken out of B_lap; the GFM stiffening and the transformer taps are kept. The as-published network and this one are the two ends of the treatment the source leaves open (every line charging and bus shunt kept, every one taken out).
not_established: The threshold CgSCR of the source (eq. 40) is not computed here; it is the artifact results/final/e9_ma2024_threshold.json (on the as-published network).
How the source treats line charging and other shunts: both treatments are computed here (ma2024_as_published keeps them, ma2024_as_published_no_shunts takes them out).

nonpositive_as_published.sign_meaning_bank_all_rows: The as-published index is the smallest eigenvalue of the S_b-scaled Schur complement S_GG - S_GF S_FF^-1 S_FG of the loads-out stiffened matrix S (Y_eq of eq. 33 in symmetric form), so a nonpositive value means that this Schur complement is not positive definite. S_FF is positive definite on all 7324 rows, so by Haynsworth's inertia additivity the index is nonpositive exactly where S itself, over all 10 plants, has a nonpositive eigenvalue (366 rows of the bank). On those rows eq. 39's second form, 1/lambda_max(Z S_b), is not the index: it is positive on 366 of them.

nonpositive_as_published_no_shunts.sign_meaning_bank_all_rows: As for the as-published index: the index without shunts is the smallest eigenvalue of the S_b-scaled Schur complement of the stiffened matrix S without the loads, the line charging and the bus shunts; S_FF is positive definite on all 7324 rows, so the index is nonpositive exactly where S, over all 10 plants, has a nonpositive eigenvalue (0 rows of the bank).
